scope: Disposable loopback Auth, real SMTP capture, current Android method and official SDK only; no hosted users or mailboxes changed

checks.name: Public reset request delivers the actual Spanish template to local SMTP, including a fragment-only link and numeric Android code

The consumed email recovery link is rejected on reuse
A genuinely expired server recovery token is rejected after its configured lifetime
Repeated reset requests deliver distinct messages and the newest link can complete verification
The current Android client requests public Auth recovery, accepts the real emailed OTP and changes the password without an AAB rebuild
The official PKCE callback exchanges its one-time code using the verifier from the requesting browser
The unchanged Android/default-template flow returns official implicit credentials to the Site URL root and still validates recovery
A signup confirmation hash is rejected by the official password recovery verification

humanValidation: Real Android/iPhone email opening and Gmail inbox placement remain separate
